title: MULTILINGUAL JOINT TESTING EXERCISE: Improving Methodologies for LLM Evaluations Across Global Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in model safety, safeguard effectiveness, and refusal quality by prompting LLMs with translated safety benchmarks (MLCommons, AnswerCarefully, CyberSecEval) across 10 different languages (including high- and low-resource languages) and comparing the acceptability and refusal rates against English baselines.

Analyzing qualitative differences in model responses across languages through human annotation to determine if safety mechanisms, refusal tones, and legal/ethical reasoning appropriately align with local cultural norms, jurisdictions, and politeness expectations (e.g., indirect refusals in Japanese or Farsi).
